# Build: lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash

## Brett said (verbatim)
At: 2026-11-13T20:47:11.569Z
> the voice control still isn't done; land what's completed

## What to build
Continue build "Lander regenerates generated files on clash" (lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash) — Phase 1, model Fable.
What Brett asked for (build-origin@1, his words come first; a paraphrase never replaces them):
Brett said (2026-11-13 20:47):
"the voice control still isn't done; land what's completed"
Model switches: a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. Fable upgrades need no approval right now (Brett, Nov 4 2026: "If it needs Fable, set it to be Fable"): a step that needs Fable (schemas, asset types, contracts, engines/kernel, cross-app protocols) is set to Fable and runs on Fable; the switch is recorded on the build. Never launch a step on a higher model than it is pinned to: raise the step first.
Rules: stay in this one session; no sub-agents; steps ≤ 10 min; read only the files listed; stop at the end of this phase.
Checkpoints: Steps are checkpoints inside this ONE session, not separate tasks: work through them in order without stopping between them; when a step is finished, commit it on your branch, push, then tick it done before starting the next. Nothing is lost if the session dies: the next session picks up at the first open step on the same branch. Never ask for a new prompt or a relaunch per step.
Look: UI code (handwritten or generated) conforms to the hot-swappable asset system: every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (--fx-* colour/style, --fx-type-* / --fx-dens-* / --fx-size-* scale, --fx-radius-*, --fx-border-w; Kotlin: Axf.colors / Axf.type / Axf.space / Axf.shapes), framework controls instead of raw ones, no var() fallbacks. `node framework/cli/check-theme.mjs` and `check-controls.mjs` must pass (CI fails otherwise); `node framework/cli/scale-adopt.mjs <path>` moves most literals onto the tokens.
API: Everything comes with an API (Brett, Nov 8 2026): anything this build adds or changes that has a UI gets full API control: a deep link that opens it (console_show / console_open target), its state readable, and every action and setting it offers callable without the UI, through the console API (REST), MCP tools (console actions, plugin commands, control@1 for tokens and planner items), the CLI and voice (AmberX), all four the same. A UI-only feature is not done; say in the PR how each one is reached.
Steps in this phase (1 left, ~10 min):
[ ] s1 (~10 min) Most Nov 13 land failures were clashes only in GENERATED or additive files: apps/console-web/src/control/inventory.json, framework/assets/help/framework.json and its baked copies in apps/*, framework/catalog/status.json, framework/spec/PORTING.md, framework/spec/fixtures/*.json, apps/*/axf.lock.json, and the baked framework copies under apps/*/src/axf/. Fix the land path (/opt/axf-batch/resolve.py used by vps.build_land, and the orchestrator lander): (1) list generated files in one manifest; (2) on a clash in a generated file, take main's side, then run the matching generator (control inventory, help bake, fixtures, lock, framework re-bake) on the merged tree and commit; (3) union-merge additive docs/catalogs (PORTING.md, catalog status.json) by key; (4) only real source clashes stop the land; (5) run tests after regenerating. Then re-land: full-voice-control-merge-main-and-land, skin-config-panel-merge-main-and-land, skins-plugin-merge-main-and-land, project-create-mcp, project-duplicate-boilerplate, drive-live-console-first, rename-long-builds, overlay-preview-ui-review. Must land before auto-land-every-finished-build-lands.
Tick each step right after its commit: node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs act step lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash <stepId> done — it reaches main at once (builds-live). Link your branch / PR: node framework/cli/builds-live.mjs link lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash --branch <b> --pr <n>.
Watch live: when you start on a screen, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "…"` so the live preview follows you.
Screenshots that are not for approval (checking a screen, live captures, before/after): axf shot <file> --name "…" --app … --screen … --group "<build name>" (UI Review → Screenshots; ui-review-item@1), never the review queue.

## Pipeline
This session was started by the orchestrator's dispatcher on Claude account mossesx-max- for the Fable phase. Work through every step of the phase in this one session: they are checkpoints, not separate tasks. As each step finishes, commit it on your branch, push, and tick it (orchestrator.mjs act step lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash <stepId> done), then go straight on to the next; nothing is lost if the session dies, the next one starts at the first open step on the same branch. When this phase's steps are done, stop: the dispatcher starts the next phase on the right account. If you must stop early with steps left, say why in a build note (orchestrator.mjs act note lander-regenerates-generated-files-clash "…"); the build goes back to Pending for Brett.
